scope: composeStudioGenerationPlanDraft accepts targetKind=unit-grid and emits { targetKind: unit-grid, unitId } when a persisted pack id is present. StudioGenerationControlView uses history[0].packId or a matching unit-grid plan node packId; it never uses unitGridReadinessPackId or selectedPackId (which falls back to the readiness candidate). get_studio_generation_control pack attaches agentExecution.generationPlanDraft from the already-persisted pack.id. Session-snapshot and SSL-5 stay panel-only. Does not execute create_studio_generation_plan or dispatch. SSL5_PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION and session-snapshot schemaVersion stay 1.
